result.keyword: What is the best planner for adhd?
result.markdown:
If you mean a **physical planner**, my pick for ADHD is **Panda Planner Pro**—especially if you tend to get overwhelmed by a blank page. Current comparisons favor planners with short daily horizons, a small number of priorities, time-blocking, and an easy way to restart after missing days. [ADHD Productivity Tips](https://adhdproductivitytips.com/best-adhd-planners-adults?utm_source=chatgpt.com) [Foco ADHD Planner App](https://www.tryfoco.com/best-adhd-planner/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My picks by ADHD problem

- 🥇 **Best overall: Panda Planner Pro** — structured daily pages, priorities, and time-blocking without requiring you to design your own system. [ADHD Productivity Tips](https://adhdproductivitytips.com/best-adhd-planners-adults?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- 🧠 **Best specifically for ADHD: Clever Fox ADHD Planner** — more explicit executive-function support, including prioritization and energy tracking. [ADHD Productivity Tips](https://adhdproductivitytips.com/best-adhd-planners-adults?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- ⏰ **Best for time blindness: Brili** — particularly focused on making the passage and duration of time visible. [ADHD Productivity Tips](https://adhdproductivitytips.com/best-adhd-planners-adults?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- 📱 **Best digital option: Tiimo** — visual, timeline-based planning with reminders and ADHD/neurodivergent-oriented design. [Foco ADHD Planner App](https://www.tryfoco.com/best-adhd-planner/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) [Thawly](https://thawly.ai/blog/best-adhd-planner?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- 📝 **Best if you hate complicated planners:** a simple **undated brain-dump + daily priority pad**. The important thing is low friction rather than having 30 different trackers. [Foco ADHD Planner App](https://www.tryfoco.com/best-adhd-planner/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you want something you can **buy right now**, this is a reasonably simple ADHD-focused option:

- **FOCUSVAULT 2026 ADHD Adult Planner** - $28.95 (Calendage)

### What I'd choose for you

If you tell me **(1) paper or digital, (2) your biggest problem—forgetting, procrastination, time blindness, overwhelm, or keeping routines—and (3) your budget**, I can narrow it down to **one specific planner** rather than giving you a giant list.
